exam.title: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Azure Databricks
exam.study_prerequisites: Practical SQL and Python/PySpark, Delta Lake, streaming and batch data engineering, Azure identity/storage/networking, Unity Catalog governance, and production deployment and troubleshooting experience.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Set up and configure an Azure Databricks environment
Secure and govern Unity Catalog objects
Deploy and maintain data pipelines and workloads

review.notes: All four March 11, 2026 objective groups and every published subobjective are mapped to environment, governance, ingestion, processing, delivery, evidence, failure, and recovery decisions. Three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 36 original knowledge checks cover compute and libraries, Unity Catalog objects and permissions, ABAC/filters/masks, identity and secrets, lineage/audit/sharing, modeling and layout, batch/stream/CDC ingestion, quality, jobs, Git/testing/bundles, Spark troubleshooting, Delta maintenance, cost, and Azure monitoring. All 52 cited URLs are exact catalog entries: 48 were reachable and four O'Reilly/Udemy pages were access-blocked; none was missing or broken. The guide explicitly reconciles current Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines and Declarative Automation Bundles names with legacy DLT and published Asset Bundles wording. No upcoming blueprint change or exam retirement was announced.

findings.title: Exam language availability expanded
findings.evidence: Current credential page lists ten languages rather than English only.
findings.recommendation: Replace the outdated statement and preserve language-specific revision recheck.
findings.resolution: Replace the outdated statement and preserve language-specific revision recheck.

findings.title: Storage identity is not the query principal
findings.evidence: The Azure access connector authenticates storage on behalf of governed users.
findings.recommendation: Separate Azure storage grants from Unity Catalog principal grants and correct readiness wording.
findings.resolution: Separate Azure storage grants from Unity Catalog principal grants and correct readiness wording.

findings.title: ABAC identity affects persisted and shared data
findings.evidence: Views evaluate base-table policies for the session user; pipeline output can persist run-as filtering; provider ABAC does not travel to recipients.
findings.recommendation: Add original 120/80 example, sharing and exemption boundaries, and identity lab.
findings.resolution: Add original 120/80 example, sharing and exemption boundaries, and identity lab.

findings.title: DENY Beta is not a general data-denial privilege
findings.evidence: Current DENY scope is MANAGE ACCESS CONTROL and metastore admins are exempt.
findings.recommendation: Add specific privilege boundary, separate Beta status and answered check.
findings.resolution: Add specific privilege boundary, separate Beta status and answered check.

findings.title: Direct-view preview documentation is inconsistent
findings.evidence: Metastore page lists views in Beta while ABAC requirements exclude applying policies directly to views.
findings.recommendation: Retain supported base-table/view behavior, exclude direct-view implementation and add October 1 recheck.
findings.resolution: Retain supported base-table/view behavior, exclude direct-view implementation and add October 1 recheck.

findings.title: SQL volume paths omitted required namespace levels
findings.evidence: Paths need catalog/schema/volume before a file-relative path.
findings.recommendation: Use disposable full paths and state schemas, target table and privilege prerequisites.
findings.resolution: Use disposable full paths and state schemas, target table and privilege prerequisites.

findings.title: Current-state selection needs unique ordering
findings.evidence: A timestamp alone cannot choose a deterministic business state when changes tie.
findings.recommendation: Replace max-by/struct expansion with ranked explicit columns and an ordering contract.
findings.resolution: Replace max-by/struct expansion with ranked explicit columns and an ordering contract.

findings.title: Loaded files and business-key uniqueness are separate
findings.evidence: Previously loaded files are skipped even when modified; force disables idempotency.
findings.recommendation: Add two-versus-four row replay example and file/key reconciliation lab.
findings.resolution: Add two-versus-four row replay example and file/key reconciliation lab.

findings.title: Schema evolution and parser failure are different
findings.evidence: Defaults differ with an explicit schema; inferred addNewColumns updates metadata then fails for restart; rescued type mismatches need not trigger FAILFAST.
findings.recommendation: Add default/restart/rescue boundaries and lab/check answers.
findings.resolution: Add default/restart/rescue boundaries and lab/check answers.

findings.title: Source sequencing governs late changes
findings.evidence: AUTO CDC supports structured ordering and source-specific APIs; FROM SNAPSHOT is Python-only.
findings.recommendation: Add tied/late arrival example, tombstone retention and API/runtime scope.
findings.resolution: Add tied/late arrival example, tombstone retention and API/runtime scope.

findings.title: Automatic and legacy CDF have different prerequisites
findings.evidence: Auto CDF uses read-time metadata with Runtime 19+ on eligible Unity Catalog tables; regional rollout and limitations apply.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish feed modes, migration and retention; schedule regional recheck.
findings.resolution: Distinguish feed modes, migration and retention; schedule regional recheck.

findings.title: A flow failure is not a global rollback
findings.evidence: Warn/drop/fail have different writes and metrics; independent triggered flows can succeed.
findings.recommendation: Add 100/94/6 example, quarantine/reconciliation and publication-gate reasoning.
findings.resolution: Add 100/94/6 example, quarantine/reconciliation and publication-gate reasoning.

findings.title: Pipeline unit tests do not isolate arbitrary IO
findings.evidence: Named-table redirection does not cover paths, connectors, direct APIs or governance mutations; mocks omit row/mask controls.
findings.recommendation: Add Beta/permissions/editor/concurrency/isolation boundaries and dedicated lab checklist.
findings.resolution: Add Beta/permissions/editor/concurrency/isolation boundaries and dedicated lab checklist.

findings.title: Omitted bundle settings can reset deployed values
findings.evidence: Direct deployment compares configuration snapshots and restores defaults for removed fields; migration depends on CLI version.
findings.recommendation: Add test-target plan review and an explicit-settings rule; schedule rollout verification.
findings.resolution: Add test-target plan review and an explicit-settings rule; schedule rollout verification.

findings.title: Maintenance windows have a lifetime exception
findings.evidence: Continuous maintenance normally starts in the window; serverless lifetime can force an outside restart and email is unsupported for maintenance notices.
findings.recommendation: Add scope, notification and recovery limitations.
findings.resolution: Add scope, notification and recovery limitations.
